title: Recycling Pickup Today — Jun 17
summary: Due to the office closure in observance of Junete…
public_detail: Due to the office closure in observance of Juneteenth on Friday, recycling collection originally scheduled for Friday will take place today instead. As this information was not included in yesterday's communication, collection will begin at 11:00 AM to allow residents adequate time to prepare. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
